purpose: Provide one stopped-profile, snapshot-backed semantic-schema migration transaction that stages every version step off the live canonical database, preserves profile/Artist/Song/version identity, validates SQLite integrity, installs only a fully validated candidate, and restores the exact maintenance-owned pre-migration snapshot when installed-state validation fails.

lineage.outcome: A new N0TE application version can understand an existing Artist profile through explicit contiguous semantic-schema migration without silently losing or cross-linking durable creative identity.
lineage.capability: Shared stopped-profile semantic-schema migration with staged validation and exact snapshot rollback

legacy_rejections: in-place live migration before candidate validation
snapshot taken before exclusive maintenance ownership
claim success when post-install reopen fails

completion_proof: current-version/no-step plans are explicit and perform no migration write or maintenance ownership change
source-to-target steps must form one exact contiguous chain; missing, duplicate, out-of-order and downgrade plans fail before installation
prepare refuses existing runtime ownership; execution must acquire the shared profile lease as bounded maintenance ownership before creating rollback state or staging writes
after maintenance ownership, source schema, canonical identity and prior migration-history fingerprints are revalidated before execution
the exact RecoveryManager rollback snapshot is created while maintenance ownership prevents normal runtime from opening the profile and is revalidated immediately before installation
the live database is copied to a staged candidate; migration SQL runs transactionally only on that candidate before installation
candidate quick_check, foreign_key_check, exact profile identity and canonical Artist/Song/version/asset identity fingerprint must match the prepared source before installation
prior migration history is immutable across a step; successful history appends exactly one inspectable record per version edge with migration ID, step fingerprint and description
failed staged SQL, history validation or candidate validation leaves the live database unchanged
a fully validated candidate is atomically installed; post-install Headquarters reopen plus identity/schema/history validation is required for success
post-install validation failure attempts exact maintenance-owned snapshot restore; restore failure is explicit RECOVERY_REQUIRED rather than false rollback
maintenance lease release is required after success or rollback; release failure remains explicit RECOVERY_REQUIRED
non_scope: schema changes outside supplied bounded migration steps
next_selection_rule: After APP-01E evidence, audit APP-01A-E against every APP-01 mapped requirement. If no concrete shared APP primitive remains, close APP-01 only as a construction dependency and globally reselect from newly eligible product nodes.
